task.title: Validate structured planning coverage residuals
task.summary: Add planning compiler checks for typed decision coverage and explicit roadmap residual reconciliation.

goal.outcome: Decision-sourced planning builds carry typed decision coverage and roadmap reconciliation, and semantic/system planning cannot pass with prose-only or unresolved residual coverage.
acceptance: Planning build data supports structured decision_coverage entries keyed by row or requirement ID with coverage state and evidence refs.
Planning build data supports roadmap_reconciliation entries for implemented, active-roadmap, partial, deferred, no-work, superseded, replanned, and unmapped states.
Semantic/system planning fails or blocks when relying only on prose coverage.
Partial or unmapped residuals require owner, trigger, rationale, and evidence before planning pass.
Graph/read-model projections expose coverage and residual findings as derived views only.
TASK-specific tests cover full coverage pass, prose-only failure, partial residual blocking, and projection output.
non_goals: Do not implement decision row delta normalization.
Do not close implementation tasks from planning context.
verification: targeted TASK-111 test for planning coverage residuals

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

summary: Implemented structured planning decision coverage and residual roadmap reconciliation validation for TASK-111.

evidence: Added TASK-111 targeted fixture test before source implementation; initial run failed because planning builds lacked decision_coverage.
Ran existing gateway-preflight smoke to catch compatibility gap labels and graph-lenses smoke for projection compatibility.
notes: gateway-preflight smoke passed after preserving missing_evidence gap substring compatibility.
CodeWiki audit warning only: generated graph changed and existing graph health warnings.
tester.boundary: derive tests or test-design evidence before code changes where practical

evidence: Extended build types with CodewikiPlanningCoverageInput plus decision_coverage and roadmap_reconciliation typed inputs.
Updated planning build writer to derive decision_coverage from decision_row_resolutions/downstream_question_resolutions and preserve structured roadmap_reconciliation fields.

Updated planning gateway preflight/report to require structured decision_coverage and roadmap_reconciliation, reject prose-only reconciliation, and block partial/unmapped residuals without owner/trigger/rationale/evidence.
notes: Did not implement decision row delta normalization; TASK-110 already closed.
Did not close implementation tasks from planning context.
builder.boundary: change code until tests, roadmap acceptance, and required checks pass

test_design_evidence: Added TASK-111 targeted fixture test before source implementation; initial run failed because planning builds lacked decision_coverage.
Ran existing gateway-preflight smoke to catch compatibility gap labels and graph-lenses smoke for projection compatibility.
code_change_evidence: Extended build types with CodewikiPlanningCoverageInput plus decision_coverage and roadmap_reconciliation typed inputs.
Updated planning build writer to derive decision_coverage from decision_row_resolutions/downstream_question_resolutions and preserve structured roadmap_reconciliation fields.

Updated planning gateway preflight/report to require structured decision_coverage and roadmap_reconciliation, reject prose-only reconciliation, and block partial/unmapped residuals without owner/trigger/rationale/evidence.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Planning build data supports structured decision_coverage entries keyed by row or requirement ID with coverage state and evidence refs.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/build/types.ts adds CodewikiPlanningCoverageInput and decision_coverage; src/build/writer.ts emits explicit + derived decision_coverage from row/question resolutions; TASK-111 test asserts row and downstream question coverage.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Planning build data supports roadmap_reconciliation entries for implemented, active-roadmap, partial, deferred, no-work, superseded, replanned, and unmapped states.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/build/writer.ts normalizes roadmap_reconciliation entries with state/status, row_ids, requirement_ids, task/sprint/source refs, owner, trigger, rationale, residuals, and evidence; TASK-111 test asserts active-roadmap state is preserved.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Semantic/system planning fails or blocks when relying only on prose coverage.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/gateway/report.ts planningRoadmapReconciliationGaps now requires structured roadmap_reconciliation entries and no longer accepts prose fallback; TASK-111 test asserts prose-only evidence_mapping blocks.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Partial or unmapped residuals require owner, trigger, rationale, and evidence before planning pass.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/gateway/report.ts flags partial/unmapped roadmap_reconciliation entries missing owner/trigger/rationale/evidence; TASK-111 test asserts partial residual without owner blocks.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Graph/read-model projections expose coverage and residual findings as derived views only.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Existing graph projection consumes planning data decision_coverage and roadmap_reconciliation; graph-lenses smoke passes after writer/gate changes.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: TASK-specific tests cover full coverage pass, prose-only failure, partial residual blocking, and projection output.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: tests/tasks/TASK-111/planning-coverage-residuals.test.mjs covers full pass, prose-only block, and partial residual block; graph-lenses smoke covers projection compatibility.

closure_brief.user_intent: Repair planning coverage so accepted decision work cannot pass planning with prose-only reconciliation or unresolved residuals.
implemented_changes: Added typed planning coverage inputs to build types.
Added decision_coverage output derived from row/question resolutions.
Hardened planning gate to require structured decision coverage and roadmap reconciliation and block unresolved partial/unmapped residuals.
Added TASK-111 regression tests plus smoke compatibility checks.
acceptance_evidence: TASK-111 acceptance_mapping entries cover all task criteria.
gateway-preflight and graph-lenses smoke tests passed.
non_goals_preserved: No decision row delta implementation repeated.
No implementation tasks closed from planning context.
remaining_risks: Existing generated graph health warnings remain and should be handled by later planned repair tasks if still actionable.

risks: Gate strictness now derives decision_coverage automatically from resolutions to avoid breaking existing planning builds that already use row/question resolutions.
Existing graph health warnings remain unrelated to TASK-111 source changes.
